messages:
leah: Scheduling short maintenance for phx-gpu-rack (phx-09) 2026-07-01 02:30->03:30 UTC. Action: NIC firmware bump + soft reboot. Expect ~12% transient burst capacity drop. ops-oncall please ack.

omar: ack. plan to do single canary then 1-at-a-time. which node is the canary?

leah: Canary = phx-09-21. Wait 15m observation after canary before proceeding. We'll enable overflow routing to phx-spare if queue depth >70%.

pete: KV preseed recommended for /embeds and /active-sessions after each uncordon to avoid p99 spikes.

ops-oncall: I'll be on. If reboot >8m or p95 >25% baseline we halt. I'll publish a temp dashboard.

cost-bot: If overflow routing used, estimated additional cost ~650 USD for the window (preemptible + egress). Finance notified.

leah: Minimal run snippet:
```
kubectl cordon phx-09-21
kubectl drain phx-09-21 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=60
apply-nic-fw --node phx-09-21 --ver 1.2.9 --verify
reboot-node phx-09-21 --wait 300
healthcheck --node phx-09-21 --checks net,gpu,driver-logs
kubectl uncordon phx-09-21
```

omar: After successful canary we'll annotate node: `kubectl annotate node phx-09-21 redwood/nic=1.2.9` and upload logs to s3://redwood-ops/maint/phx/1905550000/.

leah: Comm plan: status banner T-20m, #customer-success ping T-10m, console note "phx-gpu-rack maintenance". I'll paste final runbook link before start.

ops-oncall: Got it. Standing by. :white_check_mark:
